result.title: You Only Look Multiple Times: YoloMT, a Real-Time Streaming Model on a T4
result.summary: We introduce a new model for real-time streaming captioning on a single GPU. YoloMT is a 449.8M-parameter streaming captioner that provides Pareto-frontier performance among generative vision models in its class. Distilled from a 27B teacher by SFT and GRPO, it leads every model under 1B parameters on OVO-Bench, MVBench, StreamingBench and Video-MME, answered from its captions, and beats LFM2.5-VL-1.6B and SmolVLM2-2.2B. YoloMT is designed to read more frames cheaply and make them informative, encoding each frame once and caching it as 16 tokens. This allows the model to incorporate and infer from past frames without additional vision passes, making it efficient and effective. We also provide a detailed recipe for training YoloMT, with its stages and data, as well as ablations that demonstrate the contribution of each component.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 449.8M 参数的实时流式视频描述模型 YoloMT，每帧只编码一次并缓存为 16 个 token，使模型无需重复视觉前传即可利用历史帧，并以 27B 教师蒸馏、SFT 与 GRPO 训练，在多个视频基准上以自身字幕作答。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「每帧压缩为 16 token 缓存」把历史视觉证据转成可复用的紧凑状态，可能为流式多模态推理中视觉证据的保留与低成本再访问提供线索，但论文目标是视频描述而非 latent 推理，需核查该缓存是否承担推理状态更新。
